title: A nucleotide resolution map of Top2-linked DNA breaks in the yeast and human genome
boundary: Denaturing nonproteolytic extraction and protein-selective silica retention enrich covalent protein-DNA complexes; TDP2 exposes blocked DNA ends for nucleotide-resolution library construction. Different physical selection/end-release boundary from END-seq break enrichment and queued KCl-SDS endogenous-DPC precipitation. Spo11/Top2 and organism applications remain one candidate.
evidence_scope: Published2019 primary identity/abstract and selected CC enrichment/workflow overview checked via PMC6813358; PubMed31649282 confirms DOI/year. Later CC-seq-v2 paper is a successor to compare, not separately queued. No full Methods/SI or complete version audit.

title: Single-nucleotide-resolution mapping of DNA gyrase cleavage sites across the Escherichia coli genome
boundary: Poison-stabilized gyrase cleavage complexes undergo protein-specific ChIP and a single-stranded DNA library route preserving cleavage-associated ends. Antibody-specific complex selection differs from protein-selective silica CC-seq and nonspecific DPC precipitation; antibiotic and organism changes are not separate entries. Unrelated 2025 CRISPR TOPO-seq homonym excluded.

title: S1-END-seq reveals DNA secondary structures in human cells
boundary: In-plug S1 processing converts internal single-stranded structures/gaps into DSBs before biotin end-adapter capture. This intentionally creates mapped breaks from structures, unlike baseline END-seq native breaks or registered S1-seq resection-tail junction mapping. P1 treatment and target-repeat applications stay branches.

title: SMAdd-seq: probing chromatin accessibility with small molecule DNA intercalation and nanopore sequencing
boundary: Angelicin/UVA deposits predominantly single-strand photoadducts in accessible chromatin; extracted native DNA retains them for direct nanopore current detection. Covalent small-molecule marking and retained adduct readout differ from methyltransferase footprinting and psoralen crosslink-fragment enrichment. NEMO software is not a separate protocol.

title: RecA and SSB genome-wide distribution in ssDNA gaps and ends in Escherichia coli
boundary: Protein ChIP physically selects associated DNA before non-denaturing bisulfite converts exposed ssDNA C to U while duplex regions are protected. Joint protein selection/native-single-strand marking differs from bisDRIP R-loop antibody enrichment and ordinary ChIP-seq; RecA/SSB targets remain one method.
